items.text: Log::open over a store whose leaf inside the pinned prefix is torn returns StoreError::PinMismatch stating the pin's tree size and root and the recomputed tree size and root, names no leaf, and leaves state.json unchanged.
Log::open over a store whose leaf inside the pinned prefix has one byte changed returns the same refusal, naming no leaf and leaving state.json unchanged.
Log::open over a store with a torn leaf at the index just past the pin repairs and pins it and reports the repair through recovered_to, exactly as before this change.
lys log status on a log whose pinned prefix holds a torn leaf exits 1 and prints the refusal on stderr.
lys-anchor status on an anchor whose pinned prefix holds a torn leaf exits 1 and prints the refusal on stderr.
FileLeafStore::open returns, sorted, the name of every entry in leaves/ that has the store's temporary-leaf form, does not count any of them as a leaf, and leaves each byte-identical.
Every lys log command that opens a store prints one stderr line naming the leftover temporary leaf files the store reported.
Every lys-anchor command that opens an anchor prints one stderr line naming the leftover temporary leaf files the store reported.
scripts/verify_inclusion.py exits 0 on an inclusion artifact and a leaf file from a store written after this change.
WitnessProjection records how many leaves it has folded and folds forward from that position only.
observe parses at most one leaf more than the number of leaves recorded since the previous observe through the same projection, counted on the parse path.
After every observe, the kept projection reports the same latest state for every origin as WitnessProjection::rebuild over the same anchor, including after a rollback.
